title: RPG Maker MV Crashing Randomly on Linux

posts.author: shirowildwolf
posts.body: It's odd, almost like it runs out of memory and just closes. I launch it through steam under the linux native version. Not really sure how to fix this since the 4GB patch only working on the windows EXE. Anyone found a way around this, assuming it's a memory issue like it is on windows often.

posts.author: shirowildwolf
posts.body: Running Nobara if that helps, but it runs fine for a while, then just closes. I tried the 4GB patch again and after failing 3 times it seems to have succeeded in patching this time? Hopefully that fixes it. Working on projects right now. Will keep everyone posted.

posts.author: Jinx Adnix
posts.body: Running normally on a very wonky Gentoo set up here... Could you try launching the game by "./"ing RPG Maker MV.sh? If it say something about a missing steam ID, make a file named "steam_appid.txt" containing the string "220700".

posts.body: Looks like the 4GB Patch worked... once it did work with wine. Been using MV all day and it seems stable for now. If anyone else has the issue, just keep trying the patcher. Eventually it seems to work.
